e2e.// note: Runs against the compose stack (`docker compose up -d --wait api web`), with Cypress in its own container so the host needs no Cypress binary or GUI libs. WEB_PORT/API_PORT match the compose overrides.

options.command: docker run --rm --network host -e NO_COLOR=1 -e CYPRESS_VERIFY_TIMEOUT=120000 --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CYPRESS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${WEB_PORT:-8080} -e CYPRESS_API_URL=http://localhost:${API_PORT:-3333}/api/v1 -v "$PWD":/workspace -w /workspace/apps/web-e2e cypress/included:15.21.1
